summary: Excellent across all dimensions. Workflow uses pinned action refs (v4, v2), tight permissions model, proper env/output handling, and set -euo pipefail. TypeScript is strictly typed with clear interfaces (Rule, CliArgs, ActCase); pure functions in labeler.ts enable testing; error handling is context-rich (parseConfig reports rule index + field). No dead code or duplication; run-act-tests.ts integration harness is comprehensive—spawns isolated temp repos, runs act, parses LABELS= output, asserts exact match + exit code. Readable naming throughout (assignLabels, extractLabels, stripAnsi); comments explain WHY not WHAT. Modular: labeler (logic) → cli (I/O) → act tests (integration). Meets all requirements: TDD structure implied, `bun test` runnable, act-result.txt generated, fixture-driven testing, 0-exit assertion. Would ship.
